Market today:
Central bank tightening (BoE hike, inflation warning) is a headwind for growth/tech. AI sector turbulence adds to the uncertainty. These factors directly impact your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged positions.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-70.33%), MUU (-48.29%), and SMCI (-32.54%) are showing deep losses. These leveraged and concentrated positions on margin amplify drawdowns significantly.

Watch:
Keep an eye on further central bank commentary and any developments clarifying the near-term outlook for the AI sector.

Bottom line:
Aggressively manage risk in your deeply underwater, leveraged positions to protect your margin account.
plays: Your -70.33% loss on SOXL is extreme. Consider trimming this leveraged position or setting a realistic, tighter stop to prevent further capital erosion.
With a -48.29% loss, MUU is another leveraged position demanding attention. Review its stop at 31.6 and consider if it's still appropriate for your risk tolerance.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
